g.text: Exchange Student Guide — an edit, from the student to the published article
Reads the article, follows a [[wiki link]]
Proposes an edit: Markdown with a live
Sees the error beside the field
Looks up the number: sees the reason
The change is live, and search finds it
Rate limit: five submissions an hour
Reviews the edit as a diff of the text
as it reads, with the photo
saved as a Revision, the Article updated
